title: President
tagline: Climb the table. Do not finish last.
taglineZh: 一级一级往上打，别做最后一名。

lines.en: Fifty-two cards. Three to six players.
lines.zh: 五十二张牌，三到六个人。
排位赛。一级一级往上打。

lines.en: Play singles, pairs and triples. Equal or higher takes the trick.
lines.zh: 出单张、对子或三张，点数不小于桌面就能压住。

lines.en: Pass to save your twos, or take control.
lines.zh: 过牌留住 2，或者拿下这一墩。

lines.en: Finish first to become President. Finish last and you are Scum.
lines.zh: 第一个出完当总统，最后一名是末位。

lines.en: Next round, the President takes the Scum's best cards.
lines.zh: 下一局，总统收下末位最好的牌。

lines.en: Four computer levels, hot-seat, and play on your own network.
lines.zh: 四档电脑对手、同屏热座，还有局域网。
